---
title: "Reproducing CRAN noLD Diagnostics"
format: gfm
---

This note records the Docker setup used to investigate CRAN's
`noLD.log` failure for `diffcp`.

The important finding was that `--disable-long-double` alone did not
reproduce the failure. The failure was reproduced with:

- Fedora 42, x86_64
- R-devel built with `--disable-long-double`
- R's reference BLAS, `libRblas.so`
- `scs` 3.2.7
- the SCS LS-eq finite-difference tests using `eps = 1e-10` and
  default `adaptive_scale = TRUE`

The same Fedora noLD build linked against OpenBLAS did not reproduce the
failure.

## Directory Layout

The commands below assume this layout:

```text
codex/
  diffcp/
  fedora-nold/
    Dockerfile
    Dockerfile.refblas
  fedora-nold-debug/
    scs-debug.R
    scs-eps-grid.R
    run-patched-canonical-lseq.R
```

Run commands from the parent directory:

```sh
cd /Users/naras/llms/codex
```

## Dockerfile: Fedora noLD with OpenBLAS

This image builds R-devel with `--disable-long-double` and links R
against system BLAS/LAPACK. On Fedora 42 this resolved to OpenBLAS.

Save as `fedora-nold/Dockerfile`.

```dockerfile
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 fedora:42

RUN dnf -y update && \
    dnf -y install \
      gcc gcc-c++ gcc-gfortran make \
      wget curl tar gzip bzip2 xz patch diffutils findutils file which \
      git subversion rsync \
      readline-devel pcre2-devel zlib-devel bzip2-devel xz-devel \
      libcurl-devel openssl-devel libxml2-devel \
      openblas-devel lapack-devel \
      cairo-devel libpng-devel libjpeg-turbo-devel libtiff-devel \
      libicu-devel \
      texinfo texlive-scheme-basic texlive-parskip texlive-natbib \
      java-latest-openjdk-devel \
      && dnf clean all

WORKDIR /opt/src

RUN svn checkout https://svn.r-project.org/R/trunk R-devel

WORKDIR /opt/src/R-devel

RUN ./tools/rsync-recommended

RUN ./configure \
      --prefix=/opt/R/devel-nold \
      --disable-long-double \
      --enable-R-shlib \
      --with-blas \
      --with-lapack \
      --with-readline \
      --with-x=no \
      --without-recommended-packages

RUN make -j2
RUN make install

ENV PATH="/opt/R/devel-nold/bin:${PATH}"
ENV R_HOME="/opt/R/devel-nold/lib64/R"
ENV MAKEFLAGS="-j2"

RUN Rscript -e 'cat(R.version.string, "\n"); print(capabilities("long.double")); print(extSoftVersion()); cat("platform=", R.version$platform, "\n")'
```

Build it:

```sh
docker build --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -t diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel \
  -f fedora-nold/Dockerfile \
  fedora-nold 2>&1 | tee fedora-nold/build.log
```

## Dockerfile: Fedora noLD with R Reference BLAS

This is the image that reproduced the CRAN `noLD.log` failure. It omits
`--with-blas` and `--with-lapack`, so R uses its own reference BLAS:

```text
/opt/R/devel-nold/lib64/R/lib/libRblas.so
```

Save as `fedora-nold/Dockerfile.refblas`.

```dockerfile
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 fedora:42

RUN dnf -y update && \
    dnf -y install \
      gcc gcc-c++ gcc-gfortran make \
      wget curl tar gzip bzip2 xz patch diffutils findutils file which \
      git subversion rsync \
      readline-devel pcre2-devel zlib-devel bzip2-devel xz-devel \
      libcurl-devel openssl-devel libxml2-devel \
      openblas-devel lapack-devel \
      cairo-devel libpng-devel libjpeg-turbo-devel libtiff-devel \
      libicu-devel \
      texinfo texlive-scheme-basic texlive-parskip texlive-natbib \
      java-latest-openjdk-devel \
      && dnf clean all

WORKDIR /opt/src

RUN svn checkout https://svn.r-project.org/R/trunk R-devel

WORKDIR /opt/src/R-devel

RUN ./tools/rsync-recommended

RUN ./configure \
      --prefix=/opt/R/devel-nold \
      --disable-long-double \
      --enable-R-shlib \
      --with-readline \
      --with-x=no \
      --without-recommended-packages

RUN make -j2
RUN make install

ENV PATH="/opt/R/devel-nold/bin:${PATH}"
ENV R_HOME="/opt/R/devel-nold/lib64/R"
ENV MAKEFLAGS="-j2"

RUN Rscript -e 'cat(R.version.string, "\n"); print(capabilities("long.double")); print(extSoftVersion()); cat("platform=", R.version$platform, "\n")'
```

Build it:

```sh
docker build --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -t diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  -f fedora-nold/Dockerfile.refblas \
  fedora-nold 2>&1 | tee fedora-nold/build-refblas.log
```

Check the result:

```sh
docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 \
  diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  Rscript -e 'cat(R.version.string, "\n"); print(capabilities("long.double")); print(extSoftVersion()[["BLAS"]])'
```

Expected key properties:

```text
capabilities("long.double") == FALSE
BLAS == "/opt/R/devel-nold/lib64/R/lib/libRblas.so"
```

## Install Diagnostic Dependencies

Use separate Docker volumes for the two images, so packages compiled
against OpenBLAS and reference BLAS are not mixed.

Reference BLAS volume:

```sh
docker volume create diffcp-fedora-nold-refblas-r-lib
```

Install dependencies:

```sh
docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -e R_LIBS_SITE=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v diffcp-fedora-nold-refblas-r-lib:/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("lattice", "Rcpp", "cli", "rlang", "scs", "Matrix", "RcppEigen"), repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")'
```

`clarabel` was intentionally not installed during this diagnostic path:
under amd64 emulation on Apple Silicon, Rust/rustc was unstable. The SCS
failure can be reproduced without Clarabel by removing `clarabel` from a
temporary copy of `DESCRIPTION` before installing `diffcp`.

## Reproduce the Failure

Install the package from a temporary copy, removing only the Clarabel
import for this diagnostic run:

```sh
docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -e R_LIBS_SITE=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v diffcp-fedora-nold-refblas-r-lib:/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v "$PWD/diffcp:/src" \
  -v "$PWD/fedora-nold-debug:/work" \
  diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  bash -lc 'set -e
    rm -rf /tmp/diffcp-diagnostic
    cp -a /src /tmp/diffcp-diagnostic
    find /tmp/diffcp-diagnostic/src \( -name "*.o" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "*.dll" \) -delete
    sed -i "/clarabel/d" /tmp/diffcp-diagnostic/DESCRIPTION
    R CMD INSTALL --library=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library /tmp/diffcp-diagnostic >/tmp/diffcp-install.log 2>&1
    Rscript /work/scs-debug.R'
```

The failing signature is:

```text
MODE: lsqr
pert status: solved (inaccurate - reached max_iters)
pert iter:   100000
pert scale:  1e+06
max abs D-FD dx: about 3.585e-4

MODE: dense
same perturbed solve failure and same dx error
```

This matches the CRAN `noLD.log` failure: both `lsqr` and `dense` fail
through the same inaccurate perturbed forward SCS solve.

## Isolate the Cause

Run the control grid:

```sh
docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -e R_LIBS_SITE=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v diffcp-fedora-nold-refblas-r-lib:/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v "$PWD/fedora-nold-debug:/work" \
  diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  bash -lc 'cd /work; Rscript scs-eps-grid.R'
```

The key comparison was:

```text
explicit eps=1e-10, adaptive_scale=TRUE:
  pert iter 100000, scale 1e+06, dx error about 3.585e-4

eps=1e-10, adaptive_scale=FALSE:
  base solved, pert solved, scale 0.1, dx error about 8e-10
```

So the problem is not a single-precision/no-long-double tolerance issue.
It is a solver-path instability in SCS adaptive scaling for this tiny
finite-difference perturbation when R uses reference BLAS.

## Test the Patch

The test-only patch is to set `adaptive_scale = FALSE` in the two
SCS LS-eq finite-difference tests, for both the base and perturbed
solves:

- `tests/testthat/test-canonical.R`, LS-eq `mode = "lsqr"`
- `tests/testthat/test-canonical.R`, LS-eq `mode = "dense"`

Run the patched diagnostic:

```sh
docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 \
  -e R_LIBS_SITE=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v diffcp-fedora-nold-refblas-r-lib:/usr/local/lib/R/site-library \
  -v "$PWD/diffcp:/src" \
  -v "$PWD/fedora-nold-debug:/work" \
  diffcp-fedora42-nold-rdevel-refblas \
  bash -lc 'set -e
    rm -rf /tmp/diffcp-patched
    cp -a /src /tmp/diffcp-patched
    find /tmp/diffcp-patched/src \( -name "*.o" -o -name "*.so" -o -name "*.dll" \) -delete
    sed -i "/clarabel/d" /tmp/diffcp-patched/DESCRIPTION
    R CMD INSTALL --library=/usr/local/lib/R/site-library /tmp/diffcp-patched >/tmp/diffcp-install.log 2>&1
    Rscript /work/run-patched-canonical-lseq.R'
```

Expected result:

```text
MODE: lsqr
base status/iter/scale: solved 9125 0.1
pert status/iter/scale: solved 9275 0.1
dx 7.9e-10
dy 8.4e-11
ds 1.6e-09

MODE: dense
base status/iter/scale: solved 9125 0.1
pert status/iter/scale: solved 9275 0.1
dx 8.1e-10
dy 6.2e-11
ds 1.6e-09
```

## MKL Note

The separate `MKL.log` issue was a PSD self-duality assertion in
`tests/testthat/test-cone-diff.R`. The assertion compared two equivalent
PSD projections at `1e-15`. MKL eigenvalue/eigenvector arithmetic showed
differences around `1e-14`, while the Python-reference PSD projection
check remained much looser at `1e-10`.

The test-only adjustment was:

```diff
- expect_lt(max(abs(p - diffcp::pi(x, cones, dual = TRUE))), 1e-15)
+ expect_lt(max(abs(p - diffcp::pi(x, cones, dual = TRUE))), 1e-12)
```

## Current Test-Only Patch

```diff
diff --git a/tests/testthat/test-canonical.R b/tests/testthat/test-canonical.R
@@
                                       mode = "lsqr",
                                       solve_method = "SCS",
-                                      eps = 1e-10)
+                                      eps = 1e-10,
+                                      adaptive_scale = FALSE)
@@
                                  scs_lseq_cone_dict,
                                  solve_method = "SCS",
-                                 eps = 1e-10)
+                                 eps = 1e-10,
+                                 adaptive_scale = FALSE)
@@
                                       mode = "dense",
                                       solve_method = "SCS",
-                                      eps = 1e-10)
+                                      eps = 1e-10,
+                                      adaptive_scale = FALSE)
@@
                                  scs_lseq_cone_dict,
                                  solve_method = "SCS",
-                                 eps = 1e-10)
+                                 eps = 1e-10,
+                                 adaptive_scale = FALSE)

diff --git a/tests/testthat/test-cone-diff.R b/tests/testthat/test-cone-diff.R
@@
     ## PSD is self-dual.
-    expect_lt(max(abs(p - diffcp::pi(x, cones, dual = TRUE))), 1e-15)
+    expect_lt(max(abs(p - diffcp::pi(x, cones, dual = TRUE))), 1e-12)
```
